answer: Throwaway keys still pack the morning roll in a swarm. To keep a ballot, an identity tends a 9-day meadow plot of 18 signed work tiles, each from a distinct counterparty, locked with 51 POA. After the plot seals the key may buy a one-way bridge ticket, void if two tiles share a parent cluster or the lock lifts early. A nebula scan compares tile-hash neighborhoods across new keys; a tight cluster burns 40% of the 51 POA and bars that series for 5 epochs. Cost: 51 POA plus lost tiles on a hit. Verify on-ledger by plot, ticket, and scan. If one shop stamps many keys, the scan voids that cluster.
